MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_GUARD_ONE_EVENT.title: Whose Illusion
MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_GUARD_ONE_EVENT.pages:
[jitter][b]Flames twist before your eyes, the air thick with the scent of rust and ink.[/b][/jitter]
The bonfire is no longer a bonfire—it has split open a fissure. Beyond that crack, [jitter][b]something[/b][/jitter] is watching you.
A [jitter][color=#cccccc]【voice】[/color][/jitter] emerges from the depths, as if pronouncing a verdict:
[jitter][color=#cccccc]"You have arrived. Then, let the witch trial begin."[/color][/jitter]

You step forward. The [jitter][color=#cccccc]【voice】[/color][/jitter] laughs. You feel a certain power surge into your body, but you know—the enemy ahead is no longer who you thought.
Gain 13 Max HP, upgrade a card, but the Boss will be replaced.

You step back. A [jitter][color=#cccccc]【soft sigh】[/color][/jitter] comes from within the fissure. The pain of your wounds eases, but that [jitter][color=#cccccc]【voice】[/color][/jitter] lingers in your mind.
Heal 13 HP, upgrade a card.

The fissure closes behind you. You feel your body become lighter, but your heart grows heavier. At the top of the tower ahead, what awaits you is no ordinary monster. The [jitter][color=#cccccc]【voice】[/color][/jitter] whispers in your ear:
[jitter][color=#cccccc]"Come, [/color][/jitter][b][color=#ff99cc]Witch[/color][/b][jitter][color=#cccccc]. I await you at the end."[/color][/jitter]

Your wounds heal miraculously, but your fingers tremble. Looking down at your hands, you find yourself holding a [b][color=#CC6666]pen[/color][/b]. Who gave it to you? You don't know. The bonfire returns to normal. But you know this is far from the last time you'll see that [b]illusion[/b].
